scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter '@quiescent/web' build
scripts.build:packages: bun run --filter @quiescent/git build && bun run --filter @quiescent/server build && bun run --filter @quiescent/editor build && bun run --filter @quiescent/astro build && bun run --filter @quiescent/wiki build
scripts.build:writing: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter @quiescent/web build
scripts.build:node: bun run build:packages && WRITING_RUNTIME=node bun run --filter @quiescent/web build
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run build:packages && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.types:cloudflare: node code/web/node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js types code/web/src/cloudflare-bindings.d.ts --config code/web/wrangler.writing-test.jsonc --env-file /dev/null --include-runtime false --strict-vars false
